_note: Hand-written extras for the cryptid guide pages, read by src/build_cryptid_guide_docs.py. Keyed by cryptid slug. Keys: intro_note, fixed_note (string or list of paragraphs, shown at the top of Fixed Spawn Locations), maps_expand, gallery [{file, caption, credit}].

blue-devil.fixed_note: The Blue Devil has a fixed spawn at Naked Creek in Skyline Valley. When lightning hits the satellite dish at that camp, the game starts a Storm Encounter, and a Blue Devil spawns at one of two spots next to the dish.
